verdict.rationale: LangGraph is an orchestration framework and platform, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The pack shows no such server. The only MCP evidence is client-side: MCPAdapter lets LangChain agents call tools on external MCP servers, which does not count for this server story. The Agent Server launched by the CLI is described as exposing endpoints for runs, threads and assistants, with no mention of MCP.
